change_log.Description: Register created for the AKOS catalogue. Seeded with the three tools published in this repository. This register is itself an instance of TSP.3.
TSP.4 Tool Installer registered. First entry with no skill - recorded to show the register handles tools whose value is not an agent interface.
TSP.5 registered. Generalised from a personal reference-material system and a per-project document control list that turned out to be one tool at two scopes.

tools.Description: Work breakdown / backlog register per project: decomposition, effort, acceptance criteria, sprint allocation, with a generated dashboard.
tools.Notes: Ready to adopt. Template ships inside the skill folder.

tools.Description: Risks, Actions, Issues, Decisions and Ideas per project, with a probability x severity heat map and a generated dashboard.
tools.Notes: Ready to adopt. Register is built programmatically; no template file.

tools.Description: The inventory of tools, systems and procedures, plus the recurring controls that keep them alive. The spine of the method - this register is an instance of it.
tools.Notes: Ready to adopt. Open item: Primary Area vocabulary resolved.

tools.Description: Vendors a tool from this catalogue into a project, records where the copy came from, and keeps it reconcilable with upstream: drift detection and three-way updates.
tools.Notes: Ready to adopt. No skill by design - it runs at moments where a human decides.

tools.Description: Inventory of the artifacts belonging to a scope - documents, folders, tools and physical items - recording what each is, where it lives digitally and physically, what contains it, and which tool governs its contents. The register assigns an ID that is written onto the artifact itself, so its claims about the filesystem can be checked.
tools.Notes: Ready to adopt. The only tool here that reconciles against reality rather than itself.
